helsinki.note: Helsinki neonatal EEG (Stevenson et al. 2019): 79 term neonates (39 with consensus seizures), 19 referential 10-20 electrodes at 256 Hz, ~74 min median; label = seizure per second by majority of 3 experts. Neonatal seizures are focal, rhythmic and evolving, often low-amplitude and from one region; morphology differs from adult seizures. Published neonate-independent concatenated AUROC: SVM (Tapani) ~0.955, deep nets ~0.96-0.98.
